What I did.

  1. Coordinated with Japan Development Institute and JICA in the capacity development of BEZA and BIFFL.
  2. Prepared documentation, SPC formulation, shareholder agreement, equity investment policy and project agreement as special assistance activities for Special Economic Zone development.

The assignment.

Provide support and reports for the JICA consultant on indigenous norms and systems of administrative operations, enabling advice to BIFFL and BEZA on designing an equity investment system and forming a sound SPC with an investor.
